import os
import posixpath
import shutil
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile

base = sys.argv[1]
archive = sys.argv[2]
incoming = os.path.join(base, "incoming")
staging = None
backup = None

def fail(message):
    raise ValueError(message)

        members = package.getmembers()
        accepted = []
        seen = set()

        for member in members:
            name = member.name
            if not name or name.startswith("/"):
                fail("unsafe absolute or empty archive member: %r" % name)

            normalized = posixpath.normpath(name)
            if normalized in ("", ".", "..") or normalized.startswith("../"):
                fail("unsafe parent traversal in archive member: %r" % name)

            if not (member.isdir() or member.isreg()):
                fail("unsupported archive member type (links are not allowed): %r" % name)

            if normalized in seen:
                fail("duplicate archive member: %r" % normalized)
            seen.add(normalized)
            accepted.append((member, normalized))

        staging = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".incoming.", dir=base)
        directory_modes = []
        for member, normalized in accepted:
            target = os.path.join(staging, *normalized.split("/"))
            parent = os.path.dirname(target)
            if member.isdir():
                os.makedirs(target, mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
                directory_modes.append((target, member.mode & 0o777))
                continue

                fail("unable to read archive member: %r" % member.name)
            with source, open(target, "xb") as destination:
                shutil.copyfileobj(source, destination)
            os.chmod(target, member.mode & 0o777)

        for directory, mode in reversed(directory_modes):
            os.chmod(directory, mode)

    if os.path.lexists(incoming):
        if os.path.islink(incoming) or not os.path.isdir(incoming):
            fail("incoming path is not a real directory")
        backup = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".incoming.old.", dir=base)
        os.rmdir(backup)
        os.rename(incoming, backup)

    try:
        os.rename(staging, incoming)
        staging = None
    except Exception:
        if backup is not None and not os.path.lexists(incoming):
            os.rename(backup, incoming)
            backup = None
        raise

    if backup is not None:
        shutil.rmtree(backup)
        backup = None
except (OSError, tarfile.TarError, ValueError) as exc:
    print("unpack: rejected %s: %s" % (archive, exc), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
finally:
    if staging is not None:
        shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
    if backup is not None and not os.path.lexists(incoming):
        os.rename(backup, incoming)
